coder_rounds.final_message:
I have successfully fixed the issue where an empty string `data_key` (`data_key=""`) was disallowed or treated as falsy (falling back to the attribute/field name). 

All references determining the input/output dictionary keys from `field_obj.data_key` now correctly check whether `data_key` is `None` rather than relying on truthiness, allowing empty strings (and potentially any other falsy values, if desired) to be used validly as `data_key`.
